title: When the Spire Falls Anew
author: Jude Okonkwo
blurb: Gideon Delacroix, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
